title: TransportState
description: Snapshot of the transport, returned by every transport command and emitted on the 'transport://state' app event when state or position jumps discontinuously. Mirrors Rust struct audio::TransportState.

positionSamples.description: Playhead position in samples at sampleRate, measured from project start (0).

sampleRate.description: Engine sample rate in Hz (e.g. 44100, 48000). All *Samples fields in the IPC surface are in this unit.

tempoBpm.description: Project tempo in beats per minute.

loopEndSamples.description: Loop region end (exclusive), in samples. 0 when no loop region is set.

songEndSamples.description: Last audible sample of the current material: the maximum of every clip end and the final scheduled note-off, recomputed by the engine on each structural rebuild. 0 when there is nothing to play. Derived state — never sent by a client.

stopAtEnd.description: Policy: stop the transport when the playhead reaches songEndSamples. The engine detects the crossing regardless; this decides whether it acts on it. Ignored while a loop is active or while recording.

countInLeftSamples.description: Samples of count-in still to play before a pending take arms. 0 when idle. Derived — never persisted, never sent by a client.
